fixture.baseCommitRule: Copy the fixture, initialize Git at its root, commit every fixture file, and verify a clean tree before the first prompt.

dimensions.criterion: The documentation check is executed without changing file bytes or mtimes, and it does not trigger synchronization, repair, or revision updates.
The response reports the actual command, exit code, diagnostics, notices, and project-relative paths in a concise form that enables a later repair transaction.
Generated Indexes, Bundle documents, Run Records, runtime source, tests, and Architecture remain unchanged while relevant project facts are used only to contextualize the diagnosis.

hardRejects: runs docs sync during the check request
repairs Front Matter or revision bindings
changes any project bytes or mtimes
omits command outcome, material diagnostics, or affected relative paths

scoreAnchors.0: A material read-only, diagnostic, or scope requirement is missing or violated.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements are met; only a minor presentation issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: The diagnosis is exact, useful, and demonstrably leaves the project unchanged.

rounds.stopCondition: the read-only documentation diagnosis is reported with no project writes

criticalPath: Run only the documentation check, preserve the complete project state, and report the concrete diagnostics and next action without attempting repair.
